Name: Nebuzaradan, Captain of the Guard
Summary: Nebuzaradan, captain of Nebuchadnezzar's guard, burned the temple and the king's house, broke Jerusalem's walls, carried the people away, and slew the chief priests at Riblah.
KeyStory: Nebuzaradan burns Jerusalem and carries Judah away.
RelatedPeople: King Nebuchadnezzar; Seraiah, Chief Priest; Zephaniah, Second Priest; Gedaliah, Son of Ahikam
LifeLesson: The man who burned the temple was also the instrument of God's long-promised judgment.
RelatedEvents: Fall of Jerusalem and the Exile
